scope: Cumulative RTK project statistics, not model usage or an A/B experiment
measurement: RTK estimates command-output tokens using bytes / 4; input means raw command output, output means filtered command output
limitations: Sparse cumulative records from 2026-07-17 to 2026-10-08; no matched baseline or task-quality comparison
732 of 846 command records are from 2026-08-11; the sample is not balanced across dates or tasks
RTK reported saved exceeds input minus output by 130; the discrepancy is retained and its cause is not established
No provider billing, parent/child token usage, prompt content, command arguments, raw history, usernames or private paths are included
